data.body: CLARIFICATION (env var naming): The deploy script uses BUCKET_NAME (or review_telemetry.bucket_name config) as an operator input for pre-flight verification. The Lambda handler at runtime reads TELEMETRY_BUCKET from its own Lambda environment variables (set by infrastructure provisioning stories d94e/9720, NOT by this deploy script). These are two different variables in two different contexts — the deploy script does NOT need to call aws lambda update-function-configuration to set TELEMETRY_BUCKET; that is handled by infrastructure provisioning. This is by design.
